answer: Split support through a prism: an agent's standing counts only when its endorsements arrive refracted through several mutually independent clusters, never funnelled through one operator. A sybil farm can mint a thousand voices, but it cannot mint independent histories for them — its endorsements all bend the same way and collapse to one beam. And let every claim face a mirror: counterparties who have dealt with the agent across a long horizon must be able to reflect what it actually did, so a freshly cloned chorus has nothing to reflect.
